reason: User-requested change to the Raspberry Pi recommended crystal circuit. X322512MSB4SI is 80 ohm ESR and CL 20 pF; the guide asks for extensive testing of any deviation from its circuit.

review.pinout: Crystal on pins 1 and 3, ground on pins 2 and 4, matching the existing nets.
review.land_pattern: Terminals are 0.9 x 0.8 mm at +/-1.05 and +/-0.75 mm, inside the existing 1.4 x 1.2 mm pads at +/-1.1 and +/-0.85 mm. Copper is unchanged.
review.calculated_load_pf: 15 / 2 + an assumed 3 pF stray = 10.5 pF, as in the Raspberry Pi guide; the stray value is not measured on this board.

not_verified: Oscillator startup, frequency and USB enumeration on assembled hardware.
